title_sq: Ne Zonen e Bllokut, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Totalisht I Investuar !!
description_sq: Ne Zonen E Bllokut, Shitet apartament 2+1, Totalisht I Investuar. Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 80 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 5-te banim te nje pallati 11-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome per femije dhe tualeti. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike dhe elektrike, sistem kondicionimi Chiller, parket teper cilesor, dritare dopioxham termike, mobilim cilesor dhe elektroshtepiake te markave me te njohura. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Lindje. Aktualisht eshte i dhene me qera 700 euro ne muaj. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote Hipotekor.
title_en: In the block area, 2+1 apartment for sale, fully invested!!
description_en: In Block Area, 2+1 apartment for sale, Totally Invested. The apartment with a total area of ​​80 m2 is located on the 5th residential floor of a well-managed 11-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor, which is distributed in the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom, a children's room and a toilet. The apartment is fully invested, starting from the plumbing and electrical installations, Chiller air conditioning system, high quality parquet, thermal double-glazed windows, quality furniture and household appliances of the most popular brands. The orientation of the apartment is East. It is currently rented for 700 euros per month. The property has full mortgage documentation.
